description-zh: Ruby程序的入口函数示例，包含命令行参数处理和异常处理
description-en: Entry point function example for Ruby programs, including command line arguments and exception handling
code:
#!/usr/bin/env ruby

require 'optparse'

# 主程序类
class Main
  def initialize
    @options = {}
  end

  def parse_options(args)
    OptionParser.new do |opts|
      opts.banner = "Usage: #{$PROGRAM_NAME} [options]"

      opts.on("-n", "--name NAME", "Name to greet") do |name|
        @options[:name] = name
      end

      opts.on("-h", "--help", "Show this help message") do
        puts opts
        exit
      end
    end.parse!(args)
  end

  def run(args = ARGV)
    # 解析命令行参数
    parse_options(args)
    
    # 打印程序信息
    puts "Program: #{$PROGRAM_NAME}"
    
    # 打印命令行参数
    puts "Arguments count: #{args.length}"
    puts "Arguments: #{args.inspect}"
    
    # 程序主要逻辑
    name = @options[:name] || 'World'
    puts "Hello, #{name}!"
    
    return 0
  rescue StandardError => e
    warn "Error: #{e.message}"
    warn e.backtrace if $DEBUG
    return 1
  end
end

# 如果是直接运行此文件
if __FILE__ == $PROGRAM_NAME
  exit Main.new.run
end

description-zh: 使用 Net::HTTP 发送简单 GET 请求（失败返回 nil）
description-en: Send simple HTTP GET using Net::HTTP; nil on failure
code:
require 'net/http'
require 'uri'

def http_get(url, timeout = 5)
  uri = URI.parse(url)
  http = Net::HTTP.start(uri.host, uri.port, use_ssl: uri.scheme == 'https', open_timeout: timeout, read_timeout: timeout)
  req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(uri)
  res = http.request(req)
  res.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess) ? res.body : nil
rescue StandardError
  nil
end

def utf8_truncate(s, limit, suffix = '...')
  return s if s.nil? || s.length <= limit
  s[0, limit] + suffix
end

description-zh: 递归地将 Hash 的字符串键转为符号键
description-en: Recursively symbolize string keys in Hash
code:
def symbolize_keys(obj)
  case obj
  when Array
    obj.map { |v| symbolize_keys(v) }
  when Hash
    obj.each_with_object({}) do |(k,v), h|
      key = k.is_a?(String) ? k.to_sym : k
      h[key] = symbolize_keys(v)
    end
  else
    obj
  end
end

description-zh: 递归合并两个 Hash，后者覆盖前者
description-en: Recursively merge two Hashes; right overrides left
code:
def deep_merge(a, b)
  a.merge(b) do |_k, v1, v2|
    v1.is_a?(Hash) && v2.is_a?(Hash) ? deep_merge(v1, v2) : v2
  end
end

description-zh: 使用 Net::HTTP 发送 JSON Body 的 POST 请求(支持超时)，返回响应文本或 nil
description-en: Net::HTTP POST with JSON body (timeouts); return body or nil
code:
require 'net/http'
require 'uri'
require 'json'

def http_post_json(url, obj, timeout = 5)
  uri = URI.parse(url)
  req = Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri)
  req['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
  req.body = JSON.dump(obj)
  http = Net::HTTP.start(uri.host, uri.port, use_ssl: uri.scheme == 'https', open_timeout: timeout, read_timeout: timeout)
  res = http.request(req)
  res.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess) ? res.body : nil
rescue StandardError
  nil
end
